result:
The decisive mistake was WebSurfer's action at step 12.

At step 10 the Orchestrator told WebSurfer to scroll down the season pass page and find the price details. WebSurfer instead clicked "Link for Daily Tickets" and left that page. Later steps then mostly revisited the same pages. The season pass page was never read further, so no 2024 pass or daily ticket price was found. The run then stalled and ended with the unsupported answer "200" instead of $55.

AGENT: WebSurfer
STEP: 12
